narrative_purpose: Full-bleed atmospheric mood layer behind the chapter: a vast lightless abyssal plain that sets the feeling of a world where the decisive chemistry happened in the dark, unwitnessed.
subject: An ultra-wide panoramic view across an endless dark abyssal seafloor from a high vantage, the plain receding for miles with only the faintest scattered pale suggestions of distant mineral chimneys far below and far off, no single bright focal subject — only the slow dim glow of warm fluid somewhere in the deep distance.
scene: An immense lightless ocean basin at great depth, the floor dissolving into layered water haze long before the horizon, the water column above it entirely dark.
camera: An extreme wide, high-vantage panoramic view, distant and contemplative, the seafloor low in frame.
light: Very low overall; a few faint far-off glimmers of teal from distant vent fluid as the only light, deep indigo water swallowing everything at middle distance, no bright highlights anywhere.
palette: Dominated by void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, with only sparse dim teal glow far below; deliberately dark and low-contrast throughout.
style: Painterly speculative-biology plate, atmospheric, hand-painted depth, everything soft.
detail_level: Soft and low-contrast throughout, all detail dissolving into water haze, no crisp focal element anywhere.
composition: Wide horizontal panorama with deep atmospheric layers, the seafloor kept low, a vast dark water column above it, the faint glows small and distant — built to sit behind long-form text.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, dark and atmospheric, intentionally low-contrast as a background layer; no bright subject and no near-field detail to compete with overlaid text.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no bright focal point, no foreground subject, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
